newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST -- Czech Republic -- Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST -- Czech Republic -- Jan 6.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The cabinet has decided to put a total of 1.2 billion crowns into a programme to help small and medium-sized businesses this year. This is 200 million crowns more than last year.
- Industry and Trade Minister Vladimir Dlouhy regards a request from the head of Poldi Steel, Vladimir Stehlik, for 1.5 billion crowns for compensation, as extravagant.
- Skoda Plzen is planning internal changes this year aimed at livening up operations of the company. They are planning to lay off 635 "non-quality" workers.
- The Trade Ministry is offering electricity producers and distributors a compromise which would make it possible to set up an independent central energy control commission.
- Mining company OKD in Ostrava and Prosper Trading will replace IPB Group and GES as the majority shareholders of Moravskoslezska Teplarna, the largest heat producer in northern Moravia.
MLADA FRONTA DNES - Czechs placed a record total of approximately 40 billion crowns into various lotteries, gambling machines and casinos this year.
PRAVO - Two significant members of Swiss-Dutch TelSource, which owns a 27 percent stake in telephone operator SPT Telecom, have resigned from SPT's supervisory board in the past few days.
LIDOVE NOVINY - On Saturday afternoon, Prezident Vaclav Havel married Czech actress Dasa Veskrnova to the surprise of his aquaintances and many Czechs.

- Aero Vodochody plans a reduction in its basic assets. The choice of investors, which was to bring up to 950 million crowns to Czech aircraft producers has so far not advanced and the Defence Ministry's order of 18 billion crowns is still not fulfilled.
